purpose: Full rerun of Cube Stacking lgp_split_smart vs lgp_split_global (Table tab:planning_sr / tab:planning_time), replacing numbers that were mathematically impossible under N=50 (96.7%, 93.3%) and whose backing raw data was never committed to git.
note_on_timeout: Old default was 300s, the same class of artificial-cap bug already found and fixed for FMB (d300637e). Raised to 3600s here to mirror FMB's 'no wall-clock cap, memory cap only' approach while keeping a sane outer bound; 16GB memory cap is still the effective limiter for the Global policy at high magnitudes.
scope: 5 magnitudes (4-8 cubes) x 2 redundancy modes (nr, r) x 5 scenarios (s01-s05) x 10 trials x 2 policies (lgp_split_smart, lgp_split_global) = 1000 solver invocations. lgp_combined not rerun (4cubes data already valid; harder magnitudes assumed to fail per existing established logic).
machine: Ubuntu box, 32 cores, 30GB RAM (per nproc/free at launch time)

post_hoc_fix_2026-09-19.what: 8cubes/s02/nr/trial_01 (both lgp_split_smart and lgp_split_global) originally failed with a 16-17GB memory-cap kill. Root cause: experiments/scenes/8cubes/s02/random_trials/trial_01_nr.g had obj_03's Left/Right placement markers misnamed 'rect_1_Left'/'rect_1_Right' instead of following the 'obj_03_Left'/'obj_03_Right' convention every sibling object in the same scene uses. core/utils.py::parse_and_inject renames markers by matching the '{obj_id}_{suffix}' pattern, so the misnamed markers were never renamed to 'rectprism_4_Left'/'rectprism_4_Right', leaving codegen's terminal '(on rectprism_4_Left cube_1)' referencing a frame absent from the scene. The FOL/LGP parser logs this as a WARNING ('parsing parent ... unknown') rather than failing cleanly, and the search then balloons memory linearly (~360MB/s) until the 16GB cap kills it -- the memory exhaustion is a downstream symptom, not the actual defect.
post_hoc_fix_2026-09-19.verified_isolated: Grepped all 4-8cubes scene files for the same non-'{obj_id}_' marker-naming pattern; this is the only occurrence in the whole dataset.
post_hoc_fix_2026-09-19.fix: Renamed the two marker frames in trial_01_nr.g to follow the standard convention, then reran both policies for this one scene in isolation to confirm.
post_hoc_fix_2026-09-19.effect_on_8cubes_nr_final_results: lgp_split_smart 98.0%->100.0% (50/50), lgp_split_global 96.0%->98.0% (49/50). final_results_summary above already reflects the corrected numbers.
